cross_section_drift_findings.note: These are not citation gaps but architectural-consistency findings that should accompany the gap table for §1.0. Each maps onto an `inconsistent-with` edge in phase2-edges.csv.

drift_findings.issue: Uses informal 'resonant motion' for what §1.2 canonicalizes as 'resonant kinēsis'.
drift_findings.recommendation: Replace 'resonant motion' with 'resonant kinēsis' in T_3 description; add footnote forward-pointing to §1.2's canonical introduction.

drift_findings.issue: Frames phantasia as the WHOLE-CHAIN temporal medium binding past/present/future; §1.3 positions phantasia at A_3 only.
drift_findings.recommendation: Sharpen the temporal-medium claim: phantasia is the FACULTY through which the chain becomes temporally synthesized — the temporal medium of the soul (Heideggerian sense), but the chain itself rests on motion-and-time as A_0 (§1.1) and on the residual motion at A_2 (§1.2).

drift_findings.issue: Frames phantasia as generating 'continuous narrative' (synchronic only); §1.4 distinguishes synchronic-chain vs diachronic-saturation.
drift_findings.recommendation: Acknowledge in a single sentence (or footnote) that the continuous narrative is BOTH synchronic (each A_0 → A_4 run) AND diachronic (each new run starts from a thrownness-modulated baseline of prior phantasmata) — full distinction developed in §1.4.

drift_findings.issue: Line 64 describes A_2 → A_3 as 'the actualization of the completed cognitive actuality (made possible by the phantasma as object of thought)' — but per C074 (line 62) A_3 IS the phantasma proper, while the completed cognitive actuality is A_4 (per the five-node statement at C054).
drift_findings.recommendation: Rewrite the A_2 → A_3 sentence at line 64: 'A_2 → A_3 is the actualization of the phantasma proper (made possible by the resonant kinēsis at A_2)'; then add a separate sentence for A_3 → A_4: 'A_3 → A_4 is the actualization of the completed cognitive actuality (made possible by the phantasma as object of thought).' This brings the description into alignment with the canonical numbering.

drift_findings.issue: Roadmap describes 'A_3's subsequent sections analyze the cognitive engagements of the phantasma at M_3 → A_4' — but in the canonical numbering, M_3 → A_4 is the orectic motion to action; the cognitive engagements are at A_3 (the phantasma itself) or the M_2 → A_3 phantastic motion.
drift_findings.recommendation: Sharpen the roadmap: 'A_3's subsequent sections analyze the cognitive engagements of the phantasma — intellection, memory, deliberative-speculative phantasia, and the orthogonal committal dimension of doxa — at A_3, before tracing how the completed cognitive actuality at A_4 mobilizes orexis (M_3 → A_4) into appetitive action.'

drift_findings.issue: Says 'flips the latent resonant orexis into the determinate higher-order pathē' — but §1.4's articulational-concretion thesis distinguishes basic affective valence (with sub-types pathos simpliciter and resonant orexis) from pathē; the introduction's compression elides this tripartite distinction.
drift_findings.recommendation: Either (a) keep the compression in the roadmap but add a footnote forward-pointing to §1.4 for the full distinction, OR (b) introduce the basic-affective-valence / pathos-simpliciter / resonant-orexis triad explicitly in the introduction.
